list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Add initial components, hooks, theme constants, and utility scripts for Expo app foundation
Introduced foundational components such as `ThemedText`, `ThemedView`, and `Collapsible`, along with hooks for color scheme management (`use-color-scheme`) and theme utilities. Added support files for handling modular project resets, parallax views, and icon mapping for cross-platform consistency. Included editor configurations (`.vscode`, `.idea`) and README for project setup guidance.
